v36_screenshot.description: CYC4-008. Shows OPEN_INVENTORY on screen, then asks the caller's client for a screenshot ten seconds later. The owner opens the inventory when the title shows. Expect SCREENSHOT action=requested on the server, then SCREENSHOT action=saved side=CLIENT file=screenshots/inv_open-<tick>.png, and the picture showing the inventory.
commands: devtool checkpoint cue OPEN_INVENTORY title sound

v36_bad_label.description: CYC4-008. A label with a slash is refused before anything is sent. Expect an ERROR and no SCREENSHOT record.
